name.title: Name
name.description: The name of this platform in the logs

refreshRate.title: Refresh rate
refreshRate.description: Seconds between two status polls of a device (300 by default, 30 at least), stretched to keep within the day's requests

updateRate.title: Update rate
updateRate.description: Seconds between polls while a curtain or a blind moves (5 by default)

pushRate.title: Push rate
pushRate.description: Seconds HomeKit's writes are gathered before a command is sent (0.1 by default)

maxRetries.title: Attempts
maxRetries.description: Attempts of a request that gets no answer (2 by default)

delayBetweenRetries.title: Delay between attempts
delayBetweenRetries.description: Milliseconds between two attempts (3000 by default)

hostname.title: API address
hostname.description: Another address for SwitchBot's OpenAPI (https://api.switch-bot.com by default)

webhookURL.title: Webhook URL
webhookURL.description: The address, reachable from the Internet, where SwitchBot's cloud posts changes. The bridge listens on its port and adds a secret segment to its path

allowInvalidCharacters.title: Keep names as they are
allowInvalidCharacters.description: Do not remove from device names the characters HomeKit does not take

deviceConfig.title: Options by device type
deviceConfig.description: Options for every device of a type, by its OpenAPI type (Bot, Curtain, Hub 2…)

irdeviceConfig.title: Options by remote type
irdeviceConfig.description: Options for every IR remote of a type, by its remote type (TV, Fan, Others…)

openApiRefreshRate.title: Refresh rate (5.x)
openApiRefreshRate.description: The refresh rate of the plugin's 5.x block, read when options.refreshRate is not set

dailyApiLimit.title: Daily requests
dailyApiLimit.description: Requests SwitchBot allows the account a day (10,000)

dailyApiReserveForCommands.title: Reserved for commands
dailyApiReserveForCommands.description: Requests of the day kept for commands: polls stop when only these are left (1,000)

dailyApiResetLocalMidnight.title: Count from local midnight
dailyApiResetLocalMidnight.description: Count the day's requests from local midnight instead of midnight UTC

co2AbnormalThreshold.title: CO₂ alert level
co2AbnormalThreshold.description: Parts per million from which a Meter Pro CO2 reports abnormal carbon dioxide (1000)

writeDebounceMs.title: Write debounce (5.x)
writeDebounceMs.description: Milliseconds HomeKit's writes are gathered, from the plugin's 5.x block, read when options.pushRate is not set

enableBLE.title: Bluetooth
enableBLE.description: Turn Bluetooth off for every device with false; devices on BLE/OpenAPI then use the cloud

blePollingEnabled.title: Bluetooth status reads
blePollingEnabled.description: Read the state of plugs, lights and locks on Bluetooth every interval, besides their advertisements (on by default)

blePollIntervalMs.title: Bluetooth read interval
blePollIntervalMs.description: Milliseconds between two Bluetooth status reads (600000, at least 60000)

configDeviceType.title: Device type
configDeviceType.description: The OpenAPI type, when the cloud reports none

configRemoteType.title: Remote type
configRemoteType.description: The remote's type, when the cloud reports none

connectionType.title: Connection
connectionType.description: How the device is reached: Bluetooth only, the cloud only, or Bluetooth with the cloud when Bluetooth fails. Bluetooth reaches Bots, Curtains, Meters, Contact and Motion Sensors, Plug Minis (US, JP), Color Bulbs, Strip Lights, Blind Tilts and Smart Locks (with their key); other devices use the cloud

customBLEaddress.title: Bluetooth address
customBLEaddress.description: The device's MAC address, when it is not its device id

blePollingEnabled.title: Bluetooth status reads
blePollingEnabled.description: Read its state on Bluetooth every interval, besides its advertisements

blePollIntervalMs.title: Bluetooth read interval
blePollIntervalMs.description: Milliseconds between two Bluetooth status reads (600000, at least 60000)

disablePlatformBLE.title: No Bluetooth
disablePlatformBLE.description: Never reach this device over Bluetooth

refreshRate.title: Refresh rate
refreshRate.description: Seconds between two status polls of this device

updateRate.title: Update rate
updateRate.description: Seconds between polls while it moves

pushRate.title: Push rate
pushRate.description: Seconds HomeKit's writes to it are gathered before a command is sent

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.description: Show the changes SwitchBot's webhook reports for this device

offline.title: Offline as off
offline.description: Show the device off, closed or locked when nothing can reach it

external.title: Accessory of its own
external.description: Publish it as an accessory of its own instead of on the bridge (a DIY remote is by default)

firmware.title: Firmware
firmware.description: The firmware revision to show instead of the reported one

disableCaching.title: Always send the position
disableCaching.description: Send the position even when it is already there

type.title: Shown as
type.description: The HomeKit service a Bot, a Relay Switch or an Others remote shows as (a switch by default; an outlet for a remote)

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: The Bot's mode: a switch, a press, or as many presses as HomeKit's writes

pushRatePress.title: Seconds between repeats
pushRatePress.description: Seconds between two sends of a repeated command (15)

allowPush.title: Send unchanged
allowPush.description: Send the command even when the state does not change

hide_co2.title: Hide the CO₂ sensor
hide_co2.description: Leave out the carbon dioxide sensor

convertUnitTo.title: Webhook temperature unit
convertUnitTo.description: 4.x's conversion of the webhook's temperatures; Fahrenheit is converted to Celsius anyway

set_minLux.title: Lowest lux
set_minLux.description: Lux shown for the dimmest level (1)

set_maxLux.title: Highest lux
set_maxLux.description: Lux shown for the brightest level (6001)

hide_motionsensor.title: Hide the motion sensor
hide_motionsensor.description: Leave out a Contact Sensor's motion sensor

hide_contactsensor.title: Hide the door sensor
hide_contactsensor.description: Leave out the lock's door contact sensor

activate_latchbutton.title: Latch switch
activate_latchbutton.description: Show the Latch switch, which unlocks at once (shown unless turned off)

hide_leak.title: Hide the leak sensor
hide_leak.description: Leave out the Water Detector's leak sensor

dry.title: Invert the leak
dry.description: Report a leak when the Water Detector reports dry

set_min.title: Lower threshold
set_min.description: A curtain at or above this position shows open, a blind at or below it closed; a fan remote's lowest speed

set_max.title: Upper threshold
set_max.description: A curtain at or below this position shows closed, a blind at or above it open; a fan remote's highest speed

set_minStep.title: Step
set_minStep.description: The step of the position, brightness, humidity or speed

setOpenMode.title: Opening speed
setOpenMode.description: The speed of the moves that open it

setCloseMode.title: Closing speed
setCloseMode.description: The speed of the moves that close it

silentModeSwitch.title: Silent mode switches
silentModeSwitch.description: Two switches that make the next moves silent

disable_group.title: Show the group's other curtain
disable_group.description: Show the secondary curtain of a group too (the master moves the group)

mapping.title: Position mapping
mapping.description: How the blind's tilt becomes a HomeKit position

adaptiveLightingShift.title: Adaptive Lighting shift
adaptiveLightingShift.description: Mireds added to Adaptive Lighting's colour temperature; -1 turns Adaptive Lighting off

customize.title: Learned buttons
customize.description: Send the learned buttons On button and Off button instead of on and off

customOn.title: On button
customOn.description: The learned button that turns it on

customOff.title: Off button
customOff.description: The learned button that turns it off

commandType.title: Command type
commandType.description: The commandType sent with the learned buttons (customize by default)

disablePushDetail.title: Only on and off
disablePushDetail.description: Never send other commands (volume, speed, settings)

rotation_speed.title: Speed
rotation_speed.description: Show a speed for a fan remote

swing_mode.title: Oscillation
swing_mode.description: Show oscillation for a fan remote

stateless.title: Two buttons
stateless.description: Show a light remote as an On and an Off button

hide_automode.title: No auto mode
hide_automode.description: Leave out an air conditioner's auto mode

set_max_heat.title: Highest heating
set_max_heat.description: An air conditioner's highest heating temperature, °C (35)

set_min_heat.title: Lowest heating
set_min_heat.description: An air conditioner's lowest heating temperature, °C (0)

set_max_cool.title: Highest cooling
set_max_cool.description: An air conditioner's highest cooling temperature, °C (35)

set_min_cool.title: Lowest cooling
set_min_cool.description: An air conditioner's lowest cooling temperature, °C (0)

meterType.title: Linked meter type
meterType.description: The type of the SwitchBot meter whose temperature an air conditioner shows

meterId.title: Linked meter
meterId.description: The device id of that meter
